title.en: Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (Port Limits — Suspension) Notification 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (Port Limits — Suspension) Notification 2019 and comes into operation on 8 April 2019 at 12.01 a.m.

heading.en: Suspension of Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (Port Limits) (Amendment) Notification 2018 (G.N. No. S 790/2018)

text.en: 2. Items (3A), (3B) and (3C) of the Schedule to the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (Port Limits) Notification 2010 (G.N. No. S 215/2010) are suspended pending an agreement between the Government of the Republic of Singapore and the Government of Malaysia on the maritime boundary delimitation in the area surrounding the Johore Bahru port limits off Tanjung Piai and Singapore port limits off Tuas which is yet to be agreed upon by the Government of Malaysia and the Government of the Republic of Singapore under the 1995 Agreement.

3. In paragraph 2, “1995 Agreement” means the Agreement between the Government of Malaysia and the Government of the Republic of Singapore to Delimit Precisely the Territorial Waters Boundary in Accordance with the Straits Settlements and Johore Territorial Waters Agreement 1927 done at Singapore on 7 August 1995.
